goal: Build a Claude-subagent teacher that produces (prompt, gad-cli) tool-call pairs for SLM distillation. Spawn a cheap-model subagent (default haiku-4-5) with a strict system prompt that forces it to emit only the gad CLI command for a given natural-language instruction. Capture pairs as JSONL into data/distilled_pairs.jsonl. Includes a small hand-curated seed in data/gad_tool_pairs.jsonl that bootstraps Stage 2.5 fine-tune before the auto-distillation loop runs. Out of scope: OpenCode (descoped 2026-05-05 — see feedback memory).
